exhibitors.name: Waymo
exhibitors.note: Its co-CEO gives the Tuesday-night keynote. Waymo now carries public riders in Las Vegas, so guests may be able to ride a robotaxi during CES.

exhibitors.name: Stellantis
exhibitors.note: Its CEO keynotes Wednesday morning, and the booth continues the keynote story with new vehicles and software demos. Its 14 brands include Jeep.

exhibitors.name: Ford
exhibitors.note: Back on the CES floor for the first time since 2020. A headline return for the 60th anniversary.

exhibitors.name: Uber
exhibitors.note: First-ever CES show-floor booth. Ride-hailing meets autonomy.

exhibitors.name: BMW
exhibitors.note: Long-time CES staple for in-car tech, displays and the "ultimate driving" software story.

exhibitors.name: Kia
exhibitors.note: Korean automaker; future-mobility and EV concepts.

exhibitors.name: Hyundai Mobis
exhibitors.note: Hyundai Group's parts and tech arm: in-cabin displays, sensors, software-defined vehicle tech.

exhibitors.name: Geely Auto
exhibitors.note: Major Chinese automaker with EV and intelligent-cockpit tech.

exhibitors.name: Aptiv
exhibitors.location: Aptiv Pavilion, Convention Center Dr. & Paradise Rd.
exhibitors.note: Software-defined vehicle and autonomy supplier with its own pavilion just outside LVCC.

exhibitors.name: Bosch
exhibitors.note: Engineering giant spanning mobility, smart home and sensors. Its stage hosts mobility talks all week.

exhibitors.name: Valeo · FORVIA · Yazaki
exhibitors.note: Top-tier auto suppliers: lighting, sensing, interiors, wiring and electrification.

exhibitors.name: Brunswick
exhibitors.note: Marine tech: smart, electric and assisted-docking boats. "Mobility on water."

exhibitors.name: Caterpillar · John Deere · Oshkosh
exhibitors.note: Heavy machinery goes autonomous: construction, farming and specialty vehicles. Crowd favorites for their giant machines.

exhibitors.name: AMD
exhibitors.location: experiential space in LVCC Central Plaza (its first)
exhibitors.note: Chips for AI PCs, gaming, data centers and cars. A new hands-on space this year.

exhibitors.name: Lenovo
exhibitors.note: Tech World @ CES, an immersive "Human + AI" keynote, with AI startups featured in Sphere's atrium. Booth location TBA.

exhibitors.name: MediaTek
exhibitors.note: Chips behind phones, TVs, smart devices and AI at the edge.

exhibitors.name: SK hynix
exhibitors.note: Memory for AI (HBM). Pairs well with Tuesday's "The New Memory Economy" session.

exhibitors.name: Cadence
exhibitors.location: LVCC West Hall (first real exhibit, moving beyond meeting rooms)
exhibitors.note: Chip design software and AI tools for engineers.

exhibitors.name: Corning
exhibitors.note: Specialty glass for phones, cars and displays.

exhibitors.name: ElevenLabs
exhibitors.location: LVCC North Hall (moved up from CES Foundry)
exhibitors.note: Voice AI: lifelike speech, voice agents and dubbing. (Amy can mention that voice AI like hers is on show here, without naming her own vendor.)

exhibitors.name: Napster
exhibitors.note: The famous music brand is back with a new business direction. Expect surprises.

exhibitors.name: Samsung Electronics
exhibitors.note: Confirmed by CTA. In 2026 Samsung ran its own exhibition zone at the Wynn instead of the LVCC, so Amy should tell guests to check the CES app for 2027. TVs, appliances, smart home, AI.

exhibitors.name: LG Electronics
exhibitors.note: OLED TVs, AI appliances and home robots. Usually one of the show's most photographed booths.

exhibitors.name: LG Innotek
exhibitors.note: Camera modules, sensors and lighting for cars and devices.

exhibitors.name: Garmin
exhibitors.note: Wearables, aviation, marine and in-car tech.

exhibitors.name: Snap
exhibitors.note: Smart glasses and AR. Pairs well with Thursday's XR sessions.

exhibitors.name: Ceragem
exhibitors.note: Korean wellness and thermal-massage tech. A natural fit with the new CES Health Hub.

exhibitors.name: Emotiv
exhibitors.note: Brain-sensing (EEG) wearables, applied to driver attention and wellbeing.

exhibitors.name: Sabi
exhibitors.note: Brain-computer interface in a hat-shaped device, highlighted by CTA as groundbreaking. One of 2027's "exploration" headlines.

exhibitors.name: Korean Humanoid Area (M.AX Alliance)
exhibitors.location: LVCC South Hall (manufacturing and robotics hub)
exhibitors.note: Showcase of humanoid robots from Korea's Manufacturing AX Alliance.

exhibitors.name: Wirobotics · bHaptics · Maum AI · Mobilint · Kolmar Korea
exhibitors.note: Korean innovators: wearable robots for walking assistance (Wirobotics), haptic suits for XR (bHaptics), AI models and chips (Maum AI, Mobilint), and beauty and health manufacturing (Kolmar Korea).

exhibitors.name: Eureka Park
exhibitors.note: Over a thousand startups from around the world, the best place to "discover the next big thing first." Plan at least half a day.

exhibitors.name: Chile Global Pavilion
exhibitors.note: Chile's first national pavilion.

exhibitors.name: Sony
exhibitors.note: "Sony's sitting this one out, the first time since 1967. If you love their tech, Thursday's home-entertainment and gaming sessions are your best substitute."

exhibitors.name: Panasonic
exhibitors.note: "Panasonic won't have its own booth this year."
